verses.text: Yahweh told Moses:
“Give the Israelites these instructions: ‘When you enter Canaan, here are the borders of the land you’ll receive as your inheritance.
Your southern territory will stretch from the wilderness of Zin along Edom. On its eastern end, the southern border will start at the end of the Salt Sea.
The border will curve south of the ascent of Akrabbim and pass through Zin. It’ll go south of Kadesh Barnea, then run to Hazar Addar and on to Azmon.
From Azmon it’ll turn toward the brook of Egypt and end at the sea.
“‘On the west, the Great Sea and its coastline will be your border.
“‘Here’s your northern border. Mark it out from the Great Sea to Mount Hor.
From Mount Hor, mark it out to the entrance of Hamath. The border will pass by Zedad.
Then it’ll go to Ziphron and end at Hazar Enan. That’s your northern border.
“‘Mark out your eastern border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
From Shepham the border will go down to Riblah, east of Ain. Then it’ll go down to the eastern shore of the Sea of Chinnereth.
The border will follow the Jordan down to the Salt Sea, where it ends. Those are the borders all the way around your land.’”
Moses told the Israelites, “This is the land you’ll inherit by drawing lots. Yahweh has commanded that it go to the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
The tribes of Reuben and Gad have already received their inheritance by ancestral family, and so has the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Those two tribes and the half-tribe received their land across the Jordan from Jericho, on the east side toward the sunrise.”
Yahweh told Moses:
“Here are the men who’ll divide the land among you for your inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
Choose one leader from each tribe to help divide the land.
Here are their names. From Judah: Caleb son of Jephunneh.
From Simeon: Shemuel son of Ammihud.
From Benjamin: Elidad son of Chislon.
From Dan: Bukki son of Jogli, their leader.
From Joseph’s descendants, for Manasseh: Hanniel son of Ephod, their leader.
From Ephraim: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, their leader.
From Zebulun: Elizaphan son of Parnach, their leader.
From Issachar: Paltiel son of Azzan, their leader.
From Asher: Ahihud son of Shelomi, their leader.
From Naphtali: Pedahel son of Ammihud, their leader.”
These were the men Yahweh told to divide the land of Canaan among the Israelites for their inheritance.
